acceptance-meme.name: Acceptance Meme

bird-torpedo.name: Bird Torpedo

ballpark-pun.name: Ballpark Pun
ballpark-pun.what: A joke that plays on the double meaning of "ballpark figure" (an approximate number) by giving the literal seating capacity of a baseball stadium instead. It originated from internet humor communities.

dream-meme.name: Dream Meme
dream-meme.what: A phrase used to jokingly attribute the origin of an idea or statement to a dream, often for humorous or ironic effect. It is likely a form of self-deprecating humor or a lighthearted way to introduce an unusual or unexpected thought.

relatable-parenting-moment.name: Relatable Parenting Moment

novelty-product.name: Novelty Product

gandalf-meme.name: Gandalf Meme
gandalf-meme.what: The Gandalf meme is an image macro or joke featuring Gandalf, a character from J.R.R. Tolkien's Middle-earth stories, often used to express a sense of presence or witness to an event, originating from a scene in the movie Fellowship of the Ring.

generational-humor.name: Generational Humor
generational-humor.what: Generational humor refers to comedic content or jokes that are specific to a particular generation or age group, often highlighting the differences or quirks of that generation, originating from social media platforms and online communities.

art-fight-2026.name: Art Fight 2026
art-fight-2026.what: Art Fight is an online art exchange event where participants create art for each other, and Art Fight 2026 is the 2026 iteration of this event, which appears to have originated from online art communities.

football-criticism.name: Football Criticism
football-criticism.what: A form of commentary that criticizes decisions or actions in the football world, often using analogies or humorous comparisons. It originated from fans and pundits discussing football on various online platforms.

fifa-news.name: FIFA News
fifa-news.what: News and updates about the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA), the governing body of international football. It covers various topics such as leadership changes, controversies, and tournament updates.

relatable-dream.name: Relatable Dream
relatable-dream.what: A humorous and exaggerated expression of a common anxiety or fear, often presented in a hypothetical dream scenario, originating from online communities and social media platforms.
